description.en: Generic original ice-contact glaciofluvial sediment mound, informed by WisconsinDNR JohnsonHill moulin-kame photo and IowaDNR sediment definition. JohnsonHill is a specific moulin-kame formation example, not proof all kames form through identical cylinders; generic uneven geometry not named-site terrain. No thermal hydrothermal cementation, internal cutaway or fabricated uniform stratigraphy. Nominal80x70x24m module illustrative, not measured site. Bare sediment exposure is artistic vegetation omission.
